newsitem.title: USA: DH Technology sees Q1 sales $19 to $21 mln.
newsitem.headline: DH Technology sees Q1 sales $19 to $21 mln.

text.p: DH Technology Inc, a maker of bar code printers, printheads and related supplies, on Wednesday said it expects first quarter sales between $19 and $21 million due to softness in orders from major customers.
In addition, DH Technology said it is launching a restructuring effort that will cut its workforce and reduce executive and director pay by 20 percent.
Earlier the company reported a fourth quarter profit of $0.40 a share on sales of $28.5 million versus a profit of $0.33 a share on sales of $26.0 million one year ago.
In early January, the company said it expects first quarter results to fall below the year ago profit of $0.36 a share on sales of $28.2 million.
The company in a statement attributed the shortfall to "some major customers (who) have rescheduled and delayed shipments."
The company did not elaborate on the order softness or say how many employees it is laying off, and a spokeswoman declined to comment beyond the company's announcement.
As of March 1996, DH Technology employed just over 1,000 people, the spokeswoman said.
